descriptions.d19c_quake_random_impulse_800d6904: When offset 92 is zero: if the maximum magnitude (+136) is 0.0, read "Earthquake.ImpulseMagnitudeMax" into +136 and "Earthquake.ImpulseMagnitudeMin" into +140; sample 0x80162bc8 three times to form (2a-1, 0.5, 2b-1), scale it by the third sample times (max - min) and copy the result to +40. The random impulse interpretation is inferred.
